# Field Setting Guide

Set your team's **default fielding presets** before a match. Presets determine where your fielders stand for each phase of play.

## Two Phases

### Powerplay (PP)
Overs 1–3 of each innings. A maximum of **2 fielders** are allowed in the Outer Circle. Aggressive attacking fields dominate here.

### Normal Play (NP)
Overs 4–10. Up to **5 fielders** can be placed in the Outer Circle. Defensive and balanced spreads are common.

## Three Fielding Zones

### ATB — Attacking the Batter
Close-in positions right around the batter. High-risk, high-reward — these fielders go for catches off edges and play-and-miss deliveries.

### IC — Inner Circle
The 30-yard ring. Mid-on, mid-off, point, square leg. Controls run-scoring on ground balls and cuts off easy singles.

### OC — Outer Circle
Deep boundary fielders. Covers fours and sixes. Limited to 2 during Powerplay, up to 5 during Normal Play.

## 18 Presets

**Powerplay:** PP1 to PP9 — from most attacking (PP1) to most defensive (PP9).

**Normal Play:** NP1 to NP9 — same scale, more boundary options available.

## Preset Quality Rating

Each preset is evaluated for tactical effectiveness:

- **SUPERB** — 100% effectiveness
- **GOOD** — 89% effectiveness
- **OKAY** — 78% effectiveness
- **POOR** — 67% effectiveness
- **CRITICAL** — 56% effectiveness

Higher rating = better fielding coverage, fewer gaps for the batter to exploit.

## Best Preset by Matchup

Use these tables to pick the right preset for who's bowling and who's batting.

### Powerplay (PP)

| Bowler | vs Right-hander | vs Left-hander |
|---|---|---|
| Right-arm Pace | Off-Side · Balanced Attack · Off-Side Attack | On-Side · On-Side Attack · On-Side Defence |
| Left-arm Pace | On-Side · On-Side Attack · On-Side Defence | Off-Side · Balanced Attack · Off-Side Attack |
| Leg Spin | Off-Side · Balanced Attack · On-Side Attack · Off-Side Attack | On-Side · Balanced Attack · On-Side Attack |
| Off Spin | On-Side · Balanced Attack · On-Side Attack | Off-Side · Balanced Attack · Off-Side Attack · Off-Side Defence |
| Left-arm Spin | Off-Side · Off-Side Attack · Off-Side Defence | On-Side · Balanced Attack · On-Side Attack |

### Normal Play (NP)

| Bowler | vs Right-hander | vs Left-hander |
|---|---|---|
| Right-arm Pace | Off-Side Defence · Off-Side · Balanced Attack · Off-Side Attack | On-Side Defence · On-Side · On-Side Attack |
| Left-arm Pace | On-Side Defence · On-Side · On-Side Attack | Off-Side Defence · Off-Side · Balanced Attack · Off-Side Attack |
| Leg Spin | Off-Side · Balanced Attack · On-Side Attack | On-Side Defence · On-Side · Balanced Attack · On-Side Attack |
| Off Spin | On-Side Defence · On-Side · Balanced Attack · On-Side Attack | Off-Side Defence · Off-Side · Balanced Attack · Off-Side Attack |
| Left-arm Spin | Off-Side Defence · Off-Side · Off-Side Attack | On-Side Defence · On-Side · Balanced Attack · On-Side Attack |

## Tips

- **Powerplay:** Use attacking fields (low PP numbers) against weak batters; go neutral against strong ones.
- **Normal Play:** Tighten up when defending a small total; spread out when you can afford to give away singles.
- **Assign players to field positions** in the editor — unassigned spots lower your preset rating.
- **Your preset locks in at match start.** You can't change it mid-game, so choose wisely before the match.
